# Boiling Point of Water at Sea Level

At sea level, water boils at **100°C** (which equals 212°F).

This is the standard boiling point at **1 atmosphere of pressure** (101.325 kPa). At this temperature, the vapor pressure of water equals the atmospheric pressure, allowing bubbles of steam to form within the liquid.
